name: Childlock
tagline: Turn screen time into brain time.
description: A calm, local-first family tool that turns interruptions to a child's screen time into short brain breaks while keeping parent controls protected.

logo.notes: Use the production app icon. Preserve the sage field, bone shield, and forest lock. Do not add a wordmark or decorative effects.

colors.name: White
colors.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs, keypads, and grouped controls.

colors.name: Ink
colors.usage: Primary text, headings, and high-confidence information.

colors.name: Ink Mute
colors.usage: Captions, timestamps, inactive navigation, and supporting metadata.

colors.name: Warm Stone
colors.usage: Dividers, subtle outlines, muted controls, and disabled surfaces.

colors.name: Forest Sage
colors.usage: Primary actions, active navigation, success, and trusted status.

colors.name: Terracotta
colors.usage: Requests, attention, secondary emphasis, and small human accents.

voice.tone: Clear and operational for parents; short, warm, and age-neutral for children. Explain platform limits before users encounter them.
messagingPillars: Turn screen time into brain time.
Calmer transitions, quick learning, fewer battles.
Set up Childlock on the device your child uses.
Brain breaks and Screen Time enforcement stay available without Premium.

imagery.style: Native iOS product imagery with warm bone fields, forest-sage controls, simple rounded illustration, and large readable child interactions.
subjects: current iPhone and iPad product screens
imagery.treatment: Prefer real simulator captures and sparse vector-like illustration. Use soft solid fields and restrained depth; never glossy stock photography.

postureRules: Use generous phone margins and readable maximum widths on iPad.
Keep parent screens compact and card-led without nesting cards.
Keep child challenge screens sparse, centered, and free of parent navigation.
Use a 54pt full-width pill for the primary flow action.
Reserve 60pt or larger touch targets for child answers.
Respect native safe areas and avoid drawing fake iOS chrome.
